title: Caçarola Steam
author: Zealousideal-Bar-316
selftext:
Hey guys,

  


This is the best game we've made with AI so far: Caçarola.



It's a 4-player co-op game where you hunt down the animals for your ingredients and then cook them, Overcooked style.

  
This game is funny, hard and look gorgeous. 

  
Our other games in Steam: 

Runecast - [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5126340/Runecast/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5126340/Runecast/) 

Gacha Fiend - [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5141810/Gacha\_Fiend/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5141810/Gacha_Fiend/) 

Peso Pena - [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5296170/Peso\_Pena/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5296170/Peso_Pena/) 

Capivara Companion - [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5251320/Capivara\_Companion/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5251320/Capivara_Companion/)

comments.author: Binary-Trees
comments.body: This is fantastic! Very good job!

replies.author: Zealousideal-Bar-316
replies.body: Thanks man!! Put in your wishlist, this game are insane to play, in the tests all the Group have fun.

comments.author: SupMekBots
comments.body:
Hunting for ingredients sounds like a fun twist on Overcooked!  
  
Can players split into hunters and cooks, or does everyone need to do both?

replies.author: Zealousideal-Bar-316
replies.body: We do all together today, hunt and cook, but its a nice ideia to have this option.

comments.author: AggravatingSpring452
comments.body: Nice visuals! How did you make the sprites?

replies.author: Zealousideal-Bar-316
replies.body: We used Higgsfield, GPT image 2.5 and seedance 2.5.

replies.author: ViolinistTemporary
replies.body: Isn't seedance text to video model. How do you make working animations from that? Can you explain each one a little bit more please?

replies.author: Zealousideal-Bar-316
replies.body: He make the full animation video there, using reference of image, than he slice all the frames and make the animation. Resume, seedance will generate hundred of the frame animation.

comments.author: ViennettaLurker
comments.body: The little AI squirts are on virtual fantasy food menus as well, apparently lol

replies.author: Zealousideal-Bar-316
replies.body: We're working hard to remove every trace of the AI look. This trailer has already come a long way, but a few shots still visibly look AI-made, and we're not done yet.

comments.author: wylderzone
comments.body: Are you just making trailers and store pages to assess market fit?
